name: NexusVIP
author: CS2Nexus
description: Per-server Normal VIP (Bronze..Platinum). Owner and admins with the addvip permission grant levels; VIP gives VIP chat, !vipinfo, !vipmenu and VoteKick via ServerCommands.

commands.name: addvip
commands.description: Owner: grant or update a Normal VIP.

commands.name: vip
commands.description: Owner: list the Normal VIP players of this server.

commands.name: vipinfo
commands.description: Show your own VIP level and expiry.

commands.name: vipmenu
commands.description: Show all VIP features and which ones you have.
